author: haiku
label: seeded-07r-01
changes: No junior questions or answers were shown after the document, so this rewrite rests on the brief and the first draft only.
Replaced the nine-line draft with a summary, a terms list, six numbered steps, a failure table, a build order and open questions, in the order the skill sets.
Added the terms a newcomer needs: row count, read replica, keyset paging, job queue, worker, exports bucket, multipart upload, signed link, export record and send_email.

Added brief facts the draft dropped: the report.view check on both the click and the status, the 10,000-row threshold on the unfiltered nightly count, header row and URL filter and column order, the 24-hour link, the 7-day lifecycle rule with no cleanup job, the 512 MB worker and no whole-report-in-memory rule, the 30-minute attempt timeout, the 3-attempt retry schedule of 60 and 300 seconds, at-least-once delivery, the 60-second API limit, the 5 MB part minimum and 10,000-part maximum, read-replica-only reads, keyset paging, the failure email and failed status, and the out-of-scope list.

Added decisions the brief did not state, each marked in the steps: a unique index enforces one active export per user and report; the job payload is only the export id; status stays running during retry waits; a small-report failure returns nothing and the user clicks again; the job stops if the record is already done; the record is marked done only after the email is sent; each failed attempt and the final failure abort the upload.
Merged the draft's separate duplicate-prevention step into step 3, and folded the draft's cleanup step into the lifecycle term instead of a step of its own.
Moved the 24-hour, 7-day and 24-hour-upload-discard rules into the terms and kept each in one place, so the steps and failure table refer back rather than repeat them.
Added three open questions: email template names, whether the largest report fits in 30 minutes, and whether the page should show the download link.
The file is longer than the draft because the brief's fixed facts had to be kept; it is not padded with explanation beyond one short clause per term.
